jei.forever_skyblock.garden_exclusive: Garden mode pauses Mixing and Freezing Chambers.
gui.forever_skyblock.machine.hint_garden: Garden mode is exclusive; other chambers are paused.
gui.forever_skyblock.machine.garden_rout: 1: Below MK II  |  2: Below Garden Chamber
Main harvest: a hopper below the Condenser Mark II extracts only the first harvest output.
Secondary harvest: a hopper below the Garden Chamber extracts only the second harvest output. Both items remain accessible in this GUI.
Place the Condenser and Garden Chamber side by side, with one hopper beneath each block. 1: main harvest below MK II. 2: secondary harvest below Garden Chamber. Garden mode pauses the other chambers.
